front: Khái niệm 'Conditional Sentence Type 1 vs. Type 2' trong Unit 10: Ecotourism được định nghĩa như thế nào?
back:
Type 1: Real and possible in present/future (If + Present Simple, will + V-bare). Type 2: Unreal or hypothetical in present/future (If + Past Simple [were for all persons], would + V-bare).

💡 Ví dụ: If tourists leave trash, they will damage the coral reef (Type 1). If I had more free time, I would join an eco-tour in Phong Nha (Type 2).
🌱 Bản chất: Probability separates real conditions (Type 1) from imaginary counterfactual hypotheses (Type 2).

front: Phát biểu quy tắc / định lí: 'Use of 'were' in Conditionals Type 2'?
back:
In formal English, the subjunctive 'were' is used for all persons (I/he/she/it were) in the If-clause.

📝 Ví dụ: If I were you, I would choose an eco-friendly homestay.
🔑 Ý nghĩa: Subjunctive mood expressing non-fact.

front: Phương pháp giải bài toán: 'Put verbs into correct form (Conditional Type 2): 'If people (care) more about nature, our planet (not be) in danger.''?
back:
Các bước giải chi tiết:
Step 1: If-clause uses Past Simple: cared.
Step 2: Main clause uses would + V-bare: would not be.

👉 Kết luận: cared - would not be

front: Bẫy sai lầm cần tránh: Putting 'will' or 'would' inside the If-clause (writing 'If it will rain' or 'If I would have money').?
back:
❌ Lỗi sai: Putting 'will' or 'would' inside the If-clause (writing 'If it will rain' or 'If I would have money').

💡 Nguyên nhân & Khắc phục: Modal auxiliaries will/would belong in the main result clause, never in the conditional If-clause.
